title: "Unsupervised learning": Does Kendall vs. Pearson matter?

cues.en: Instructor: In the previous video, we discovered this may be possibly a discrepancy between Kendall and Pearson.
cues.zh: 講師：上一支影片發現，肯德爾與皮爾森之間可能存在差異。

cues.en: It was a little bit unclear whether there really was an actual discrepancy, because when we looked at this plot, where the correlation was expected to be zero,
cues.zh: 到底是否真的有差異，還不太清楚，因為看這張圖時，預期相關為 0，

cues.en: because we are just generating pure random numbers.
cues.zh: 因為產生的只是純隨機數。

cues.en: It looks like Kendall and Pearson gave very similar, you know, not exactly identical, but very, very similar numbers, correlation coefficients.
cues.zh: 肯德爾與皮爾森看起來給出相當類似的數字，也就是相關係數，並非完全相同，但非常非常相似。

cues.en: Whereas here, when we simulated these data, for which we imposed a pretty, you know, modest to reasonable correlation,
cues.zh: 但這裡模擬資料時，我們施加了中等到合理程度的相關，

cues.en: then it seems like the correlation coefficients were different, more different in size for the Kendall versus the Pearson.
cues.zh: 肯德爾與皮爾森的相關係數大小，似乎就有較明顯差異。

cues.en: So I have an hypothesis, and I want you to gather data for or against my hypothesis.
cues.zh: 所以我有個假設，希望你收集支持或反對它的資料。

cues.en: My hypothesis is that the difference between a Kendall correlation coefficient and a Pearson correlation coefficient is very small
cues.zh: 我的假設是，肯德爾與皮爾森相關係數之間的差異很小，

cues.en: when the correlations are small, close to zero, like what you see here.
cues.zh: 當相關很小、接近 0 時，就像這裡看到的。

cues.en: Conversely, the larger the correlation gets, the more that Kendall and Pearson correlations will diverge, the larger the difference between Kendall
cues.zh: 反過來，相關愈大，肯德爾與皮爾森就會分得愈開，也就是肯德爾與皮爾森

cues.en: and Pearson is going to be.
cues.zh: 之間的差異愈大。

cues.en: That is my hypothesis.
cues.zh: 這就是我的假設。

cues.en: I don't know if that's the true state of the world, but it's an empirical hypothesis.
cues.zh: 我不知道真實世界是否如此，但這是一個經驗性的假設。

cues.en: It is falsifiable, and you can test it in your data or in simulated data, and that is what you want to do with this unsupervised learning challenge.
cues.zh: 它可以被否證，也可以用你的資料或模擬資料檢驗，這就是這次無監督學習挑戰要做的事。

cues.en: Essentially, you want to compare the Kendall and Pearson correlation coefficients for a range of correlated data.
cues.zh: 基本上，要在一系列相關資料中，比較肯德爾與皮爾森相關係數。

cues.en: Just make sure it's ordinal, and it should be ordinal data, and you want to somehow figure out the difference between these two correlation types for a range
cues.zh: 要確定使用序位資料，再想辦法計算這兩種相關類型在一系列

cues.en: of correlated data from not at all correlated to strongly correlated.
cues.zh: 從完全不相關到強相關的資料中，會有什麼差異。

cues.en: So, I'm super curious what you are going to discover about the nature of the universe based on this experiment.
cues.zh: 我非常好奇，這個實驗會讓你發現宇宙的哪些特性。

cues.en: So, if you get some nice plots, if you get a nice conclusion, either way, you know, I'm an agnostic scientist.
cues.zh: 如果得到不錯的圖，或清楚的結論，無論結果如何，我是個不預設答案的科學家。

cues.en: I wanna know the truth.
cues.zh: 我想知道真相。

cues.en: I don't really have an agenda.
cues.zh: 沒有特定立場。

cues.en: I don't care if it works out one way or the other.
cues.zh: 結果是哪一種，我都不介意。

cues.en: So if you get some nice plots, if you get some nice results, then please post them to the Q and A.
cues.zh: 所以如果有不錯的圖或結果，請貼到問答區。

cues.en: I would be very happy to see what you've accomplished.
cues.zh: 我會很高興看到你的成果。
